1 — plan-defect: M1 says simEnv sets FLEET_HOME, and the Context says sim_env() is that contract 'key for key' — but the Proof's own `Run:` for leg (h) asserts sim_env() returns no key with a FLEET_ prefix other than FLEET_TEST_SLACK, which a FLEET_HOME would fail. I resolved it in favour of the executable Run: the JS simEnv() sets FLEET_HOME (leg (a) checks only the six planted names, so it passes), and the Python sim_env() sets PATH/HOME/TMPDIR/FLEET_TEST_SLACK only. M6's own text asks only that sim_env drop the six prefixes, keep FLEET_TEST_SLACK and build PATH from the same interpreters, all of which it does. Rationale recorded in the sim_env docstring: a sim is not one of its own children, and a FLEET_ fact planted by the bridge is the ambient kind the sweep exists to keep out.
